subject: Multi-method Penpot PNG recovery
body: Use live Penpot tools and keep working until one real visual export succeeds or all concrete methods below are exhausted. First call execute_code to return metadata for penpot.root.children: id,name,type,width,height,visible. Then choose a real visible child shape. Try export_shape PNG on that child ID. If it fails, try export_shape SVG on the same child. If SVG succeeds, use that evidence and try another visible child PNG. Also try execute_code directly on the selected child with await shape.export({type:'png'}) and return a diagnostic object describing constructor/type/byteLength or the exact thrown error; do not stringify raw binary. Try await shape.export({type:'svg'}) similarly. If child exports fail, create a small temporary rectangle on the current page, export that rectangle as PNG, then delete/remove it if the API supports cleanup; this is a real controlled diagnostic mutation. Preserve exact tool traces and errors. The goal is a genuine returned PNG image, not a plan. Continue across methods automatically.
design_brief: Diagnostic only: obtain one genuine Penpot-rendered PNG from the currently connected real file. Any temporary diagnostic shape must be visually simple and removable.
